drafts.title: Infotainment meets China certification and EU privacy requirements
drafts.description: Customers in China can use the full infotainment feature set and customers in GDPR regions can control and erase their driver profile data. The system presents clear in-car flows for data export and deletion and is legally certified where required.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: Infotainment obtains CCC certification for vehicles sold in China before the start of sales in China; driver profile supports data export and deletion requests and fulfils GDPR rights with deletion requests completed within 30 days and data export provided within 7 days.
assumptions: Legal interpretation of GDPR and CCC requirements remains stable through product launch
Certification timelines and test criteria are achievable within normal development schedules with local partner support
uncertainties: National implementation details (e.g., additional local requirements beyond CCC) may add time or scope
Required server/data residency arrangements and contract changes may affect delivery timing

drafts.title: Customer-requested cockpit chip (engineering specification — out of scope)
drafts.description: Some customers explicitly request the cockpit computer use the Snapdragon 8295 chip (engineering-level hardware request).
drafts.acceptance_criterion: Customer request recorded: preference for Snapdragon 8295 for the cockpit computer.
assumptions: Signal expresses a hardware preference rather than a customer-facing outcome
uncertainties: Feasibility depends on supplier selection, lifecycle and platform constraints
drafts.scope_reason: This is an engineering specification request for a specific chip; product requirements should specify customer outcomes (responsiveness, feature support) rather than a particular component.

drafts.title: Infotainment and cabin conveniences work reliably and are readable in sunlight
drafts.description: While driving customers can successfully use voice control, trust the wireless phone charger to keep their phone charging, and read the head-up and center displays in bright sunlight without needing to shade screens or block sunlight.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: In standardized real-world tests: voice control correctly interprets and executes 95% of a defined set of 50 common driving commands at cabin noise levels up to 70 dB; wireless charging maintains an uninterrupted charging state for 95% of 2-hour driving sessions across 5 representative phone models (with common cases); head-up and center displays remain legible in 95% of test cases representing direct sunlight up to 100,000 lux and sun angles 0–60°.
assumptions: Tests use a standardized command set and representative phone models (to be defined by validation team)
Acceptable definition of 'legible' will be agreed with UX (contrast, font size, and reading distance criteria)
Phone cases and third-party accessories remain within typical market prevalence
uncertainties: Extreme phone cases or non-standard devices may still fail; some connectivity-dependent voice features may vary by region
Very unusual sun angles or aftermarket window films may reduce legibility

drafts.title: Climate controls with tactile physical buttons operable without looking
drafts.description: Customers can change temperature and fan speed by feel while driving, without needing to look at the controls.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: Users can set temperature to within ±1°C and change fan speed by one level using only touch (no visual confirmation) within 2 seconds in 95% of validated user trials.
assumptions: UX validation tests reflect real driving posture and common glove usage
Control layout will be optimized for reach and tactile differentiation
uncertainties: Gloved operation or aftermarket seat position extremes could affect success rates
Regional differences in temperature units or user expectations may require localization

drafts.title: Clear value trim and fair option pricing that includes popular packages
drafts.description: Customers can buy a value-oriented 5 Series trim that includes commonly requested option packages (Comfort and Cold‑weather) without paying extra, and customers see predictable, fair dealer pricing for optional extras.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: At least one factory-configured trim is offered with a base price below $50,000 (USD) that includes Comfort and Cold‑weather packages at no additional cost; the Comfort package must also be available standalone at a price at least 30% lower than today’s Comfort package price; for optional extras advertised nationally, price variation across US dealers is ≤5%.
assumptions: A value trim with reduced feature set but key packages can be engineered at the target price
MSRP and dealer policies can be aligned to limit intra-market variation
uncertainties: Feasibility depends on material and regulatory cost pressures and regional tax/fee differences
Dealer incentives and independent dealer decisions may still affect final transaction price

drafts.title: Competitive financing, leasing and subscription options including heated seats at $15/month
drafts.description: Customers are offered leasing, financing and subscription options that make the vehicle more affordable: a competitive lease option, a promotional 0% financing plan, and a heated seats subscription at a clear monthly price.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: At launch provide: (a) at least one lease plan whose monthly payment is at least $50/month lower than a comparable Mercedes model (like‑for‑like trim) for the same term, (b) a 0% financing offer available on at least one model/trim for up to 36 months (subject to credit approval), and (c) a heated seats subscription option priced at $15 USD per month.
assumptions: Competitive comparator models and configurations will be defined for the lease comparison
Financing offers depend on retail financing partners and customer credit qualification
Subscription billing infrastructure and regional rules for recurring services are in place
uncertainties: Financing promotions may be constrained by macroeconomic conditions or finance partner risk appetite
Subscription availability and price may vary by market due to local regulation and tax
